options.content: **Green = OK, red = problem.** A component is green when all its pods are Ready. A link is green when both ends are Ready (Ingress to Flask and Auth also need 5xx errors under 5% of requests). Prometheus links are green when Prometheus can scrape the service. Flask and Auth to PostgreSQL turn red when the database is down, once the readiness probes check the database.

panels.title: Ingress → Flask API
panels.description: Ingress and Flask pods Ready, and 5xx under 5% of requests

targets.expr: (min(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="ingress-nginx",pod=~"ingress-nginx-controller-.*",condition="true"}) or vector(0)) * (min(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="backend",pod=~"vmcalc-flask-deployment-.*",condition="true"}) or vector(0)) * ((sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vmcalc-flask-service",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vmcalc-flask-service"}[5m])), 0.0001) or vector(0)) < bool 0.05)

panels.title: Ingress → Auth service
panels.description: Ingress and Auth pods Ready, and 5xx under 5% of requests

targets.expr: (min(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="ingress-nginx",pod=~"ingress-nginx-controller-.*",condition="true"}) or vector(0)) * (min(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="backend",pod=~"vmcalc-auth-deployment-.*",condition="true"}) or vector(0)) * ((sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vmcalc-auth-service",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vmcalc-auth-service"}[5m])), 0.0001) or vector(0)) < bool 0.05)
